description: 국토안전관리원_특수교량 정보 서비스 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토안전관리원. 국토안전관리원에서 관리하는 특수 교량에 대한 정보를 조회하는 서비스입니다. 사용자는 교량명, 제원, 위치, 구조형식 등 교량 개요에 대한 정보를 조회할 수 있습니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토안전관리원. Its tags are 특수교량, 해상, 교통, 다리, 안전. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
